title: Adopt exact owner command boundaries

supersedes_aspects.ADR-0012: command matching and separate deployment authority

decision: Default to read-only planning; only exact execute now authorizes the agreed implementation batch.
publish close scopes completed-batch publication; stop before any push or merge that deploys or has unknown deployment triggers.
deploy now separately binds the reviewed artifact/ref, target and necessary actions; no new implementation.
Ordinary development does not enroll a prototype run.
Preserve committed-HEAD Notion opt-in and existing narrow closeout grant.
